answer: A sybil attacker would need to acquire and provision one distinct device per identity, and a comet-timed audit randomly demands live proof, so renting fake identities costs more than honest participation. Agents must stake a unique ivory token bound to a verified hardware root before joining, and each epoch they post a signed plume challenge that no clone can forge without the physical key. Duplicate stake origins get slashed, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0168's threat model.
